chapter.introduction: In this Psalm the priests or Levites who watched all night in the temple, exhort one another, and pray for one another, ver. 1-3. A song of degrees.

content.text: Servant - Peculiarly so called, priests and Levites. Night - Not only by day, but also by night, when their watch was more necessary. Stand - Serve or minister.
Thee - Thee whosoever thou art who dost faithfully perform the duty here commanded.
